output.reason: [ev-816adf94e987] says Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated CRD API versions and that "the migration" of existing resources is part of the upgrade. The Helm hook runs it automatically; upgrades without Helm or without the hook do it with kube-storage-version-migrator. That is a migration step tied to the upgrade, so migration-required (action) fits, and the remediation follows the text. The rendered diffs [ev-d4e66123c4de][ev-9fdd5d1096ef][ev-b8120a2bb840] show v2alpha1 removed from CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy and PolicyException, which matches the versions named in the statement.
